job_title: Analista de Cadastro de Dados Mestres Júnior
summary: Create and maintain product, customer and supplier master records in corporate systems; validate requests, prevent duplicates and track approved changes.
requirements: Familiarity with spreadsheets and checking registration data; organization to follow requests and approvals; attention to field standards and duplicate handling. ERP/master-record experience is a plus. Internships and practical projects are accepted as evidence of experience.
compensation: BRL 3,500–4,500 gross per month. Additional benefits are not specified.
conditions: Remote throughout Brazil, CLT employment; JobPosting employmentType is FULL_TIME. This is master-data maintenance, not software development or data science.
